headline: IMF: Growth and Inflation in Greece and Cyprus in 2026
summary: New IMF forecasts show a significant decline in public debt and an improving labor market for Greece and Cyprus in 2026. Price increases continue to weigh on household budgets, and significant external deficits remain.
why: The IMF publishes economic forecasts for member countries, and its assessments influence investor views on sovereign debt sustainability and growth in euro-area economies.
